title: MESA MARKET
description: A farm-to-door grocery landing page with an interactive harvest stall, live crate builder, and sample receipt review.

sections.title: Market Signage Header
sections.summary: Fixed/sticky navigation with brand mark, anchor jumps to all key sections, and a live basket summary button.

sections.title: Flat-Lay Market Stall Hero
sections.summary: Floating produce stickers arranged like a curated storefront window, with headline **“Good things come into season.”** wrapping through the negative spaces. Includes a left-hand harvest category rail and primary CTA **“Fill your basket”**.

sections.title: Interactive Produce Shelf
sections.summary: Live category filters (All / Vegetables / Fruit / Pantry) that reorder and filter eight produce products (Early Girl tomatoes, Nantes carrots, Meyer lemons, Lacinato kale, Jimmy Nardello peppers, Rosa Bianca eggplant, Sebastopol apples, Red Fife sourdough). Each card features sample price, origin details, seasonal notes, and interactive increment/decrement crate controls.

sections.title: Seasonal Recipe Crates
sections.summary: Three seasonal recipe meal kits that add all required ingredients to the crate atomically in a single tap, accompanied by warm editorial kitchen photography.

sections.title: Producer Story & Delivery Loop
sections.summary: Comic-style label strips detailing field harvest, packing shed, and electric van routes, paired with a smallholder grower portrait and an illustrated inline SVG delivery map.

sections.title: Sample Checkout / Grocery Receipt
sections.summary: An itemized grocery receipt reflecting the live crate items, line totals, illustrative subtotal, and demonstration notice, alongside harvest table photography.

sections.title: Grocery-Receipt Footer
sections.summary: Clear disclosure notice, brand credits, and quick jump back to top.

sections.title: Floating Basket Pill & Drawer
sections.summary: Persistent bottom-right crate counter opening a full-featured accessible drawer dialog with keyboard navigation (Esc to close), line item quantity adjustments, clear crate action, and direct jump to the receipt review.

customCodeBlocks.title: MESA MARKET Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: MESA MARKET Interactive Runtime Bridge
customCodeBlocks.description: Loads motion, three, gsap in page footer custom code with prefers-reduced-motion guard.
